test_title: PYST 35: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘D’ is coded as ‘16’, ‘B’ is coded as ‘4’ and ‘T’ is coded as ‘400’. How will ‘H’ be coded in the same language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

‘D’ is coded as ‘16’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef22b7b10c2901f223d35d1ecf9cfe7d09f1c85cfbb82a7fb2b00237da273a36.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e5552a1c3231c90e68b0f42f7a4b2c464706e29736fdaf09505df95b8caed39.png] 

‘B’ is coded as ‘4’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/849c57da050e59f2ee8b983685a0c25b4d4db7bca142cc73ff68c95c814ab99f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23dbdb81d3134d58139ecc40231a746d43ce5672425acb8509c44b100a946500.png] 

‘T’ is coded as ‘400’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad253c02b1d97e97f4d2494939049894f573a11452dfdfa49059146e5d44e20b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b156cc1ad1383688b0b1cda5e1ef53a1b076a2c9ed1be49e28fa9f51a6b90318.png] 

Similarly, ‘H’ will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a00c618b2e048919884c04919fb9fa047a3a307fad971302162c700e265f7361.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98150f2738889b9c2bbd5d78613d6ec42cf739656280d4e8a07bfbb2f587592d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "64".
